title: ChipBlocks interfaces manifest
description: Layer 2 of the 9-layer abstraction hierarchy (per ADR-006). Interfaces are where shapes meet (contact, solder_joint, via, bond_wire) or where the design exits to the outside world (terminal, connector_pin). Each interface kind specifies the geometry it relates + any electrical / mechanical / reliability properties unique to it.

kind.description: Interface category. Each maps to specific geometry expectations + reliability characteristics.

default_properties.description: Default property values applicable to this interface kind. Each is a provenance fragment per provenance.schema.json. Examples: contact_resistance for contacts, expected_thermal_cycles for solder_joints, lead_diameter for connector_pins.
